name: LingBot-World 2.0 1.3B (image + text only)
model_version: LingBot-World 2.0 (LingBot-World-Infinity) 1.3B causal-fast (I2V, camera poses, 4-step distilled, no CFG) on Wan 1.3B; code Robbyant/lingbot-world-v2@1895d300d8ac

weights.repo: robbyant/lingbot-world-v2-1.3b-causal-fast@7e36a5f9 (DiT shards) + Wan2.1 umT5-XXL encoder, Wan2.1 VAE and tokenizer (byte-identical in robbyant/lingbot-world-v2-14b-causal-fast and Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B)

license.weights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (HF model card); Wan2.1 encoder and VAE: Apache-2.0

notes: Image-to-video world model: the released model starts from an image, so only the i2v (image + text) track is registered. 832x480 at 16 fps, 4-latent (16-frame) causal chunks generated live with upstream's causal-fast settings (4 steps, local attention 18 latents with a 6-latent sink). A prompt change applies from the next chunk (block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>', umT5 re-encoded, cross-attention cache recomputed). The camera-pose input is static (identity) by default; camera_control text is keyword-mapped onto translate / yaw / pitch pose steps (the keyword map of models/selfhost/hy_worldplay), unmappable text acked unsupported. Mid-session reference images have no model input (reference_update unsupported). Temporal RoPE table extended from 1024 to 4096 positions (same formula) for 300-second sessions.
